abstract.t:
Merge Types specify how to merge parallel edits to a resource. Parallel edits happen when two peers edit the same state over a network with latency. A Merge Type specifies how to merge conflicting changes. If the peers implement and agree upon the same Merge Type, then they will reach a consistent state eventually, whatever edits they make.
This document defines Merge Types, the structure of the Merge Type system, the Merge-Type header, and IANA registration procedures for Merge Types. Other specifications can define more Merge Types, in the registry that this document creates.
This document is one of the Braid-HTTP extensions, which work alone or together; together they make HTTP a state synchronization protocol.
